summary: Overnight Russia launched 108 Shahed/Gerber/Parodia drones from Oryol, Kursk, Donetsk TOT and Crimea-Gvardiyskoe; 85 were shot down with hits on 7 locations. Ukrainian defense forces thwarted Russian advances toward Dnipropetrovsk, regained Kupiansk positions and destroyed the Liman salient threatening Sloviansk. Three killed and seven wounded in Russian strike on Pryluky warehouses, Chernihiv Oblast.

sections.threat_assessment: Russia launched 108 drones overnight from four axes including Donetsk TOT and Crimea, indicating sustained high-tempo aerospace strikes. Southern grouping assault preparations near Sloviansk-Kramatorssk with sapper support suggest imminent ground pressure on the Kramatorsk axis. Polish PM Tusk warns of strong Russian strikes on Poland in coming weeks, raising escalation risks.
sections.regional_response: Ukraine defense forces counterattacked, thwarting Russian advances toward Dnipropetrovsk and regaining Kupiansk. Zelensky demanded Kravchenko's dismissal amid NABU corruption probe. German AfD and Weidel demand return of Ukrainian military-age men and cessation of aid. Peace talks expected to resume in October after State Duma elections.
sections.intelligence_notes: Ukrainian Prosecutor General confirmed departure from the country; NABU director Krivonos detained for document forgery. Zelensky submitted Rada motion to dismiss Kravchenko. Ukraine may receive PAC-2 Patriot production license. FSB uncovered 110 black arms dealers across 43 regions.
